ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Credential Dumping Activity Via LSASS
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects process access requests to the LSASS process with specific call trace calls and access masks.
This behaviour is expressed by many credential dumping tools such as Mimikatz, NanoDump, Invoke-Mimikatz, Procdump and even the Taskmgr dumping feature.
 Note: Unmapped fields: TargetImage, GrantedAccess, CallTrace, SourceUser, SourceImage

sequences.query: (TargetImage = RGX("\\\\lsass\\\.exe$") AND (GrantedAccess = RGX(".*0x1038.*") OR GrantedAccess = RGX(".*0x1438.*") OR GrantedAccess = RGX(".*0x143a.*") OR GrantedAccess = RGX(".*0x1fffff.*")) AND (CallTrace = RGX(".*dbgcore\\\.dll.*") OR CallTrace = RGX(".*dbghelp\\\.dll.*") OR CallTrace = RGX(".*kernel32\\\.dll.*") OR CallTrace = RGX(".*kernelbase\\\.dll.*") OR CallTrace = RGX(".*ntdll\\\.dll.*"))) AND  NOT ((SourceUser = RGX(".*AUTHORI.*") OR SourceUser = RGX(".*AUTORI.*"))) AND  NOT (((CallTrace = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\asgard2\\-agent\\\\.*") AND CallTrace = RGX(".*\\\\thor\\\\thor64\\\.exe\\+.*") AND CallTrace = RGX(".*\\|UNKNOWN\\(.*")) AND GrantedAccess = "0x103800") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Sysmon64\\\.exe$"))
